description: Adds one item to a project's Sourcing tab. fields holds the company's own Sourcing columns by key (see project: item_fields), e.g. size, qty. photo_url adds a picture (PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 10 MB). code, goes, option and cart_id are for a project Claude sources (see update_project). notes: send only the text; Guest Logic starts it with the date and AI (11/19 - AI -) itself. Owner only. Needs the owner's sign-in.

cart_id.description: The store's id for the cart button: Amazon ASIN (B0D9GB2PZP) or Walmart item id (19969702337)

code.description: Placement code: where it goes, written on its box, e.g. L01 (lobby), D01, H01, A1 (letters, digits, up to 12)

fields.description: Sourcing columns by key, e.g. {"size": "84 in", "qty": "2"}

goes.description: Where it goes, in words, e.g. "Net over the front desk; trees"

notes.description: A note, the text only (no date or AI stamp)

option.description: Option group letter (A, B…): kept out of the total until the owner ticks the option; empty clears

photo_url.description: Public https address of a picture

name: add_project_item
title: Add a project item
